## About
Marcos and Angelo Collaco started Collaco Auto Repair to give drivers superior, honest service, with a focus on Volkswagen and Audi maintenance and repairs. They're factory-trained and work on German and Japanese cars, without the cost that comes with dealerships and chains.
We're on Shell Avenue in Martinez, with easy freeway access. Neighbors come to us from Walnut Creek, Pleasant Hill, Concord and the surrounding area.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 90 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours.

## Services
- Volkswagen and Audi repair: Our specialty. Maintenance and repairs for Volkswagen and Audi owners.
- General repair and maintenance: Routine maintenance and everyday repairs for German and Japanese cars.
- Electrical and O.B.D. diagnostics: Tracking down warning lights and electrical problems.
- Brakes, clutch, engines and transmissions: Work on the parts that stop, shift and move your car.
- Heating and air conditioning: Keeping your heat and AC working through the seasons.
- Pre-purchase inspections: A look at a car before you buy it.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in German and Japanese cars, especially Volkswagen and Audi.

Q: When are you open?
A: Weekdays, Monday through Friday. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: We're based in Martinez and serve Walnut Creek, Pleasant Hill, Concord and the surrounding area.
